points.quote: `packages/frontend/` is the client side. ... `packages/backend/` ... `packages/common/` holds code shared by the client and the server
`tools/` holds the `affine` CLI (`yarn affine dev` and `yarn affine build`) plus CI and changelog helpers. - `tests/` holds the e2e and other tests
`blocksuite/` is the editor framework the app is built on.

`web` is the browser app, and `admin` is the admin dashboard. - `electron` and `electron-renderer` make up the desktop app. - `mobile` is the mobile web build, which `ios` and `android` wrap as native apps.
`native` and `mobile-native` hold Rust/native bindings ... `native` is the Rust backend code, which the server loads through `native.ts`.
The server is the NestJS backend, used for cloud and self-hosted deployments. Its `core/` modules include auth, users, workspaces ... doc storage and sync, realtime sockets
Postgres with the pgvector extension, read from `DATABASE_URL`. - Redis ... It exposes a GraphQL API (`schema.gql`)
